Description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each telecommunications customer.
Customer gender classification (Female, Male).
Binary indicator indicating if the customer is a senior citizen (1 = Yes, 0 = No).
Indicates whether the customer has a domestic partner or spouse (Yes, No).
Indicates whether the customer lives with dependents or children (Yes, No).
Total number of months the customer has stayed with the company.
Indicates whether the customer subscribes to landline phone service (Yes, No).
Indicates if the customer has multiple phone lines (Yes, No, No phone service).
Customer internet service provider technology (DSL, Fiber optic, No).
Indicates whether the customer subscribes to online security addon (Yes, No, No internet service).
Indicates whether the customer subscribes to cloud backup addon (Yes, No, No internet service).
Indicates whether the customer subscribes to device protection warranty (Yes, No, No internet service).
Indicates whether the customer subscribes to premium technical support (Yes, No, No internet service).
Indicates whether the customer streams television via internet service (Yes, No, No internet service).
Indicates whether the customer streams movies via internet service (Yes, No, No internet service).
Contract agreement duration terms (Month-to-month, One year, Two year).
Indicates whether customer opted for electronic paperless billing (Yes, No).
Customer payment disbursement channel (Electronic check, Mailed check, Bank transfer (automatic), Credit card (automatic)).
The recurring amount billed to the customer each month (in USD).
The cumulative total charges incurred over the customer tenure (in USD).
Actual historical status indicating whether customer churned in last month (Yes, No).
Binned tenure cohort segmentation (0–12 Months, 13–24 Months, 25–48 Months, 49–72 Months).
Binned monthly charges tier segmentation ($0–$35, $35–$70, $70–$90, $90+).
Model-estimated posterior probability of customer churn (continuous float between 0.0000 and 1.0000).
Predicted churn probability expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimal places (0.00% to 100.00%).
Model classification outcome using default 0.50 decision threshold (Yes, No).
Audit validation flag indicating if model prediction matches actual historical outcome (Yes, No).
Three-tier probability risk categorization (Low Risk: <0.30, Medium Risk: 0.30-0.59, High Risk: >=0.60).
Calibrated integer risk score scaled from 0 to 100 based on predicted probability.
Four-tier operational prioritization index (Priority 1 - Critical: >=0.80, Priority 2 - High: 0.60-0.79, Priority 3 - Medium: 0.30-0.59, Priority 4 - Low: <0.30).
Rule-based prescriptive retention recommendations mapped to customer risk tier and service configuration.
Operational executive filter flag identifying customers with >= 0.60 churn probability (Yes, No).
